title: The Game-Theoretic Katětov Order and Idealised Effective Subtoposes
summary: This paper addresses the longstanding problem of determining the structure of the $\leq_{\mathrm{LT}}$-order in the Effective Topos, known to effectively embed the Turing degrees. In a surprising discovery, we show that the $\leq_{\mathrm{LT}}$-order is in fact tightly controlled by the combinatorics of filters on $ω$, raising deep questions about how combinatorial and computable complexity interact, both within this order and beyond it.
